data.translation: That is, I have had an experience: the last time the “Ḥuyoḏo” board was elected, um, when I asked questions, the answers did not come back.

rationale: First Detransitive Preterit example, provisionally finite feminine mnaqyo with overt institutional patient; no separate election sense. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Famine/4)

data.turoyo: Veǧa, əzzənwa, babi ḥoṣadwa, ŭ ḥoṯi mnaqyowa hawxa šəble. Maltmowa hoool ʕaṣriye. Saymówalle boqoṯe hawxa, ŭ maltmowa. Kətwa lavlavk̇e ba+frezanək, may+yarixanək d̥kuzzá hawxa. Layfowa aʕlayye, saymówalle. ʕAṣriye məḥyówalle b̥ḥaṣa, bi+ṗəštiye mṭówalle, maḥtówalle b̥k̇aviye dadro manək dam+mārbabiye, hoool dmkamalwa u+ḥṣodo. Babi kəmmono b̥kallawat ḥoṣadwa. Hedik̇a gədmdaqəd̥qowa aš+šəblanək, mdaríwaynanne, howənwa ṭaʕno, əmṭíwaynanne lal+labaniyat.
data.translation: Then, they used to go, my father harvested, and my sister picked spikes like so. She used to go gathering until the evening. She made them into sheaves like so, and she gathered them. There was a bindweed in those stubble fields, one of those long ones, one that goes like so. She wrapped it around them, she made them. In the evening she put them on her back, she brought them in a bundle, she put them into a corner of one of those threshing floors of the Mārbobians, until he finished harvesting. I would say my father harvested for money. Then he pounded those spikes, and we winnowed them, it became a load, we brought them for yogurt cream.

rationale: Fill Infectum-wa/1 with gathering ears of grain; retain the edition's English text.

summary: All 80 occurrences reviewed. The 17 compact records lacking verses were recovered from matching bracketed citations in inputs/texts only; duplicated same-verse tokens retain separate decisions.

II.1 supports both grain as object with impurities marked m-, and unwanted material as object with retained grain or soil as source. JL 17.5/16-17 and JTM 1.1/21,36 show the alternation; no gloss change is needed because auslesen covers it.
Self-benefactive l-suffixes cooccur with nominal patients and m- selection sets (65/470, 96/227, 105/27). Human partner selection and free choice retain the existing sense.

The inherited Detransitive Part. Pass. and Infinitiv boxes have no separate numbered gloss list. Their decision label 1 refers to the entry's sole II sense; neqoyo denotes active selection, not necessarily a Detransitive event.

PrS 60/67 has a German sentence about the cat's drinking rather than the Turoyo departing harvesters; that translation is excluded from examples. The agent noun does not justify creating a new Part act. box.
Existing editions use older PrS reference numbering. Identical older-edition examples were not duplicated or automatically recited under the newer numbering.
Round 1 already filled active Infectum and Detransitive Part. Pass. to five; Jan lamb and abstract-services examples add participant evidence as notes rather than redundant quotations.
The action/removed-object alternation recurs in agricultural weeding: crop is the source domain, weed is the object. This confirms round-1 analysis.

The dated board-election clause has a feminine nominal patient and event framing. It is provisionally filed as Detransitive Preterit, not promoted solely because the English says elected. No new numbered sense is needed.
Nominal -yo in different contexts must be distinguished by agreement and clause syntax. No new purity homonym or productive ritual sense is inferred from the biblical-style lamb quotation alone.
Does mnaqyone in PrS 60/67 function as a lexical agent noun, and where should such -ono forms be filed in the glossary? Supply or align the German translation of this verse.
At 94/467, does selecting each opponent for assessment amount to 'absuchen', or should the inherited German example be clarified? The supplied context does not show a physical search.
At 44/43, does mnaqye modify wheat or loaves? Retain the inherited English rendering until attachment is settled.

Confirm mnaqənne at 73/407,409 as Preterit versus unprefixed Infectum, and the segmentation of mnaqeni (65/467) and mnaqalle with a singular ant (73/417). These uncertain forms were not promoted as new boxes.
Jan 891: confirm mnaqyo as feminine Detransitive Preterit versus an irregular result predicate with i səʕto. The proposed new box is explicitly provisional.
Jan 2832: is defect-free mnaqyo still selected/choice, or lexical pure? Current evidence supports only the existing evaluative range.
Jan 928: confirm the plural form mnaqən; the reader feminine-plural label is unsupported by mixed mothers-and-fathers antecedent.
Collecting includes growing aubergines and gleaning ears, as well as bones, pebbles and money; these participant extensions do not require numbered technical senses.
Part. Pass. mnaqyo/mnaqye ranges from selected to evaluatively excellent; religious mnaqyo d aloho is an extension of that existing evaluative use.
A defect-free lamb and outstanding services extend the already documented evaluative selected/choice mnaqyo/mnaqye. They do not independently prove a technical ritual-purity sense.
Institutional board selection and parental spouse choice use the existing choice meaning; father’s personality is metonymic for the selecting father.
